title: Freya and the Signal
author: A. M. Sterling
blurb: Rosalind Sterling, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
